assertions.claim: Across 29 labs and 43 couples datasets, the strongest predictors of relationship quality are the participants' own feelings
assertions.cn_span: 29 个实验室、43 份配对追踪数据的分析里，最能说明关系好不好的全是当事人自己的感受

assertions.claim: Perceived partner commitment, appreciation, sexual satisfaction, perceived partner satisfaction, conflict — not the partner's traits
assertions.cn_span: 感觉到对方的承诺、欣赏、性满意度、感觉到对方满意、冲突多不多，而不是对方的条件

assertions.claim: Self-reports predicted quality two to four times better than partner reports
assertions.cn_span: 自己报告的这些东西，预测力是伴侣报告的二到四倍

assertions.claim: Whether the relationship improves or worsens over time is nearly impossible to compute from any self-report questionnaires
assertions.cn_span: 这段关系往后是变好还是变坏，用任何自陈问卷都基本算不出来

assertions.claim: Relationship variables explained up to 45% of variance at baseline and up to 18% at study end
assertions.cn_span: 关系变量能解释基线时最多 45% 的方差，研究结束时最多 18%

assertions.claim: To judge the current relationship, asking your own feelings beats checking a partner-trait checklist; don't count on predicting its future
assertions.cn_span: 判断当下这段关系好不好，问自己的感受比核对对方的条件清单准；但别指望能预测它以后会怎样
